create_token_encoder: create a TokenEncoder from a Tokenizer with task, language, and mode parameters
create_raw_token_encoder: create a raw TokenEncoder with no control symbols for direct tokenization
create_token_decoder: create a TokenDecoder to decode token indices back into text strings
encode_text_to_tensor: encode text into a Tensor of token indices using a TokenEncoder
encode_text_as_tokens: encode text into a list of token strings using encode_as_tokens
